original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis

original_evidence: we identified ORFs in different tissues using the RiboCode software (https://github.com/xryanglab/RiboCode) with default parameters ; The ORFs shorter than 300 nucleotides were considered to be sORFs potentially encoding peptides. ; The resulting MS data were processed with the Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8). Tandem mass spectra were searched against the aa sequences of sORFs identified by RiboCode in the translatome data ; The false discovery rate (FDR) was adjusted to <1%, and the minimum score for peptides was set to >40. ; which are supported by the presence of one or more unique peptides (UPN ≥ 1) in the MS analysis
